properties.description:
Areas of light snow will continue across portions of far North
Georgia through around mid-morning. At elevations below 2500 feet,
little to no accumulation is expected, though a dusting may occur
on grassy and elevated surfaces. At elevations near or above 2500
feet, total accumulations up to 2 inches are possible.

Overall, travel impacts should be minimal, as recent warm
temperatures should keep most roadways clear. However, motorists
should exercise caution, particularly on bridges and overpasses
and along roadways at higher elevations where isolated slick spots
may develop. For more information or to report snowfall amounts
at your location, please visit www.weather.gov/atlanta.

north Georgia this evening as expected. Temperatures below
approximately 2500' remain just at or above freezing, meaning
no significant accumulations are expected but snow could briefly
linger on elevated or grassy surfaces through the night. Above
2500' temperatures have fallen to at or below freezing. Up to an
inch of accumulation could occur in these locations with isolated
amounts of around 2" along some of the higher peaks.

should keep roadways mostly clear, though care should be had on
bridges and overpasses, especially in elevated locations. For more
information or to report snowfall amounts at your location, please
visit www.weather.gov/atlanta.
